pull.title: KAFKA-21371: The docs of partitioner.rack.aware should mention partitioner.ignore.keys and client.rack
pull.body:
Update the doc for partitioner.rack.aware which mention
partitioner.ignore.keys and client.rack

Reviewers: Murali Basani <muralidhar.basani@aiven.io>

repo.name: kafka
repo.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

review_comments.body: I think if you set partitioner.class and rack.aware to true, but leave client.rack unset, the producer fails at construction ? So "This has no effect when a custom partitioner is used." may not be fully true ?

> When enabled, the sticky partition is chosen from partitions whose leader is in the same rack

But BuiltInPartitioner actually falls back to all available partitions when none are in the client's rack based on partitioner.class doc. So looks like there is a contradiction.

> which must be set

It's a bit vague. May be "the producer fails at construction with a ConfigException if client.rack is missing." ?

issue_comments.body: partitioner.ignore.keys doc isn't updated. Based on PR desc, it should be updated ?
